correctness.rationale: Rectification commutes with diagonal scaling, giving an exact scaled-cuboctahedron description for every centered rectangular box. Three explicit points lie in the box interior and on one triangular rectification facet. If the rectification equaled the intersection with a scaled polar, each point would have to lie on the polar boundary; equality of their three polar functionals forces a^2=b^2=c^2. Positivity gives a=b=c. The cubic converse holds with lambda=2s^2. The bundled checker verifies the cube midpoint geometry and the rational obstruction example.
